metrics.title: Result engine versus an independent oracle
metrics.method: Couples are generated by gene dropping through unrelated, second-cousin, first-cousin-once-removed, first-cousin and double-first-cousin pedigrees with ground-truth genotypes. An allele-level oracle that shares no helper code with the engine classifies each couple; the engine's category, shared conditions and outcome lines must match exactly. Ruleset rishta-safe-couple-1.0+b682d63abbf0; seed 20261120.
metrics.does_not_show: Agreement between two implementations written by the same team. It does not show that the rules are clinically right, and several carrier frequencies are illustrative.

metrics.title: Human comprehension (teach-back) study
metrics.value: Not run. A protocol exists; the ethics exemption question is unanswered.
metrics.method: Within-subject teach-back on hypothetical couples, five items, stratified by language and a literacy proxy. At n=30 an 80% score has a 95% interval of 61 to 92%, so the study would be reported with intervals, never as proof.
metrics.does_not_show: Everything: no comprehension, uptake or decision-quality claim is made.

caveats: All people, results and timelines are synthetic. Nothing here measures a real programme.
Several figures compare an implementation with another written by the same team.
Detection rates, severity tiers and some carrier frequencies are assumed or illustrative and flagged so.
Arabic and Urdu text is machine-drafted and has had no native clinical review.
No clinical review, field validation or comprehension study has been done.
